_comment: ANCIENT SCULK, in veins through the fill.
An ore feature rather than vanilla's sculk_patch, and that is not a stylistic choice: a
sculk_patch decorates an exposed surface and needs air beside it, and the compacted depths are
solid every column floor to ceiling. It would place nothing, throw nothing and log nothing.
Block REPLACEMENT is what works in solid fill, which is why every feature down here is an ore.
The target must be techno_organic_waste. Aiming at netherrack - the obvious guess for a Nether
biome - would be silently inert, because this dimension generates none.
Size 6 against slag rubble's 20, so it reads as a vein rather than a seam.
